title: Recovering the A/C refrigerant
ask: Should the A/C refrigerant be recovered by a shop before the interior strip, while the car can still be driven there?
why: B1 (strip the A/C) needs a shop to recover the refrigerant first. It is gated after the design freeze, which comes after the interior strip (S1), and by then the car can't be driven. That means a mobile service or a tow.
options:
(a) Drive it to a shop for recovery before S1: about $50-100 and an afternoon.
(b) Leave B1 where it is and use a mobile A/C service later: about $100-200.
recommend: (a), unless the system is already empty (worth a gauge check first)
